idea-plugin.name: RestfulToolkit-air
idea-plugin.description:
A toolkit for RESTful services development.

  • Jump to the handler method behind a URL (Ctrl + \ or Ctrl + Alt + N), with Ant-style matching so /product/{id} resolves /product/42.
  • RESTful services tree tool window, scanned on a background thread instead of blocking the UI.
  • Built-in HTTP request client: responses are decoded with the charset reported by the server, and non-JSON bodies are kept as they are.
  • On a handler method: Generate && Copy Full URL, Relation URL (every declared path, one per line), RequestBody (JSON) and Query Param.
  • Convert a Java or Kotlin class to sample JSON, compressed JSON or bulk field values; format JSON with Ctrl/Cmd + Enter.

Supports Spring MVC / Spring Boot and JAX-RS, in both Java and Kotlin.

一套 RESTful 服务开发辅助工具集。

  • 按 URL 直达接口方法（Ctrl \ 或 Ctrl Alt N），支持 Ant 风格路径匹配， /product/{productId} 可命中 /product/42。
  • Services Tree 工具窗口，接口扫描在后台线程完成，不阻塞界面。
  • 内置 HTTP 请求工具：按服务端声明的字符集解码，修复中文乱码，非 JSON 响应原样保留。
  • 接口方法上可复制生成完整 URL、相对 URL（多路径逐行输出）、请求体 JSON 与查询参数。
  • Java / Kotlin 实体类转 JSON、压缩 JSON、批量字段值；Ctrl/Cmd + Enter 格式化 JSON。

支持 Spring 体系（Spring MVC / Spring Boot）与 JAX-RS，支持 Java 和 Kotlin 语言。

本插件是 RestfulToolkit（原作者 mrmanzhaow）的维护分支，沿用其 Apache-2.0 授权，支持 IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1 ~ 2026.2。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 本分支继承自上游 RestfulToolkit（作者 mrmanzhaow）及其修复版 RestfulToolkit-fix，以下 2.1.6 及更早的记录为上游历史，此处保留不做改写。
  • 1.0.0 本分支独立版本线的起点（对应上游 2.1.6 之后的维护版本），改动：
    适配 IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1 ~ 2026.2（build 251 ~ 262.*），构建迁移到 JDK 21 / Gradle 9 / IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.13；
    恢复并修复 Kotlin Spring 路由解析，兼容新版 Kotlin PSI API；
    支持一个映射注解声明多个路径时的 URL 生成与逐行复制，并修复 @RequestMapping(params = ...) 条件参数未参与 URL 生成的问题；
    响应体改为按字节读取并解析 Content-Type 声明的字符集，修复中文乱码，非 JSON 响应内容不再被丢弃；
    YAML 配置读取支持 --- 多文档分段；完善 List 泛型解析并补齐请求体 JSON 组装逻辑；
    相比上游移除了 JSON→POJO 反向生成、Live Template、Spring Boot 代码生成器等模块，聚焦路由解析与 URL 生成。
  • 2.1.6 Stability and performance pass:
    the Services tree scan now runs on a background read action instead of blocking the EDT;
    fixed ClassCastException / IndexOutOfBoundsException / NPE crashes in the Spring and Kotlin resolvers;
    HTTP requests now have connect and read timeouts;
    "Convert to JSON" no longer degrades after a self-referential class is converted;
    server.port / context-path lookup now reads application.yaml and falls through profiles correctly.
  • 2.0.8 修复2022.3版本报错问题
    黑色主题下请求参数的面板也改为黑色
  • 2.0.7 Bug fixed
  • 2.0.6 Bug fixed, add Copy Query Param (Key Value)
  • 2.0.5 Bug fixed, supported http request OPTIONS,TRACE,CONNECT methods.
  • 2.0.4 Fixed NullPointerException with Kotlin project.
    Fixed IllegalArgumentException: No enum constant com.zhaow.restful.method.HttpMethod.HEAD
    Supported Kotlin 1.2 level.
  • 2.0.3 Improvements in navigate service(url), auto pasted copied http url to from clipboard.
    Bug fixed.
  • 2.0.2 Match mapped URLs for Controllers without @RequestMapping annotations;
    Supported mapped URLs for Controllers extended supper Object with @RequestMapping annotations.
    Added Popup Menus ( "Copy Full Url", "Jump to Source") for service nodes.
  • 2.0.1 Fixed JSON generation issue with POJO contains array fields;
  • 2.0 Add Kotlin language supported;
    Fixed some bugs.
  • 1.1 Supported JAX-RS;
    Format JSON data , use "Command + Enter" on Mac (增强 POJO 生成 json 功能,处理 List、Enum等类型，处理自关联场景);
    Fixed some bugs.
  • 1.0.9 Service url navigation: matched restful style request mappings (e.g.:"/product/{productId}");
  • 1.0.8 Bug fixed
  • 1.0.7 Match more mapped URLs ; (识别更多映射)
    Replaced icons;
    Add "Convert to JSON (Compressed)" function to java class;
  • 1.0.6 Compatible with IDEA 2016 (兼容 IDEA 2016)
  • 1.0.5 修复发送请求IDE卡死的问题.
  • 1.0.4 Format Date type (格式化 Date 类型)
  • 1.0.3 Small cleanup some code.
